task.description: Independently re-verify REQ-255's marker insertion within docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-051..REQ-078 entry range, with YAML validity and scope-leakage checks.

result.note: All 9 checks independently re-derived from scratch (nothing trusted from DOC-UPDATER's handoff), all confirmed: (1) `git diff 6b32f91c..HEAD --stat` shows exactly `docs/requirements.yaml` (58 insertions, 0 deletions) plus this run's own `handoffs/WF02-REQ255-20260906/step-00-git-setup.json` -- no other file touched, zero deletions. (2) Range boundaries independently grepped: `- id: REQ-051` at line 2757 in both before (6b32f91c) and after (HEAD); `- id: REQ-079` at line 4573 before, 4631 after (delta of 58 matches the 58 inserted lines exactly). All 58 diff hunks (`git diff 6b32f91c..HEAD -- docs/requirements.yaml`) fall with old-line ranges strictly inside [2757,4572] -- the last hunk's old range is 4565-4571, before REQ-079's original 4573 start; every added line is a `PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):` marker (grep confirms 0 non-marker `+` lines). (3) `.zig` count restricted to [2757,4572] in before-tree vs [2757,4630] in after-tree: 142 -> 142, identical, as claimed. (4) `python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('docs/requirements.yaml')); print('OK')"` -> OK. (5) Sample-diffed 9 entries (REQ-051,052,053,054,055,056,066,067,078) by extracting each entry's full block and stripping PROVENANCE/`# PROVENANCE` lines before diffing against the pre-change block: all 9 diffs empty (byte-identical citation text once markers stripped); markers observed both as bare lines (first line of `description: >` folded scalars) and as `# `-prefixed YAML comments immediately above `title:` lines and `acceptance_criteria` bullets -- correctly placed, no field's own scalar syntax is broken (comment lines sit between list items / above key lines, never inside a folded scalar or a quoted string). (6) Commented-out S4 section-header block found at line 3684 (`  # PROVENANCE...` immediately above `  # ---------------------------------------------------------------` / `  # S4 -- api-surface`); confirmed this is one continuous run of `#`-prefixed lines from 3684 through 3802 (ending immediately before `- id: REQ-065`) containing multiple `.zig` mentions (`src/api/*.zig`, `routes/sandbox_access.zig`, `routes/agent_sandboxes.zig`, etc.) and exactly one marker at the top, no re-marking mid-block -- a defensible, correctly-scoped application of the design's per-unit (not per-line) rule, neither under- nor over-marked. (7) `grep -rnE 'unlike R-Co|deliberately diverges|diverges from R-Co'` restricted to the range: 1 hit both before and after, byte-identical text (line offset shifted from 1129->1158 purely due to markers inserted ahead of it, expected). (8) Whole-file `.zig` total is 728 in both before and after trees (zero net change, consistent with zero deletions); out-of-range count = 728-142 = 586 in both before and after, confirming no leakage into sibling chunks. (9) `grep -c '\.zig' CLAUDE.md README.md docs/migration/README.md` = 0/0/0 in the working tree -- untouched, as expected (no action was needed there). No discrepancies found against DOC-UPDATER's claims; all counts independently reproduced exactly (142 unchanged, 58 markers inserted, 187->245 whole-file PROVENANCE total, 0 deletions, single-file scope). PASS -- clears the gate for TEST-DESIGNER.
